name: Kuroyanagi Hiroshi
source:
An incompetent school teacher who is looked down on by both colleagues and students alike. He has a severe case of Lolita complex and has even gone as far as to set up hidden cameras in the school bathrooms. He has fallen straight into the main heroines trap, but is such a sick weirdo that he’s actually enjoying it.

Job: 4th Grade Teacher
Symbol: Joker

[From Steam]
